next_human_action: Open one completely fresh ChatGPT conversation and send exactly `Prometeo P-ZM-01`. Nothing else. The worker response does not need to be copied back; on the next parent turn inspect the durable run/return paths first.
parent_next_turn_rule: If expected run path is absent: classify NOT_LAUNCHED and repeat only the same tiny launch action.
If run is STARTED/WORKING: acknowledge actual start from durable evidence and inspect for return/terminal state.
If BOUNDARY/FAILED: read terminal reason/evidence, repair protocol/job if possible, allocate explicit retry run, do not pretend success.
If DONE and return exists: verify ordering, scope, recovered facts and no transcript dependence; record canary PASS/integration and unlock B-CHATOBJ-01.
important_boundaries: Do not claim P-ZM-01 has started before its run file exists.
Do not ask the human to copy the worker response back to the parent.
Do not launch P-CC-01..06 before the canary passes.
Do not treat worker return as Current/Human Accepted/Served authority.
